scope: Close the formal-render lifecycle and metadata-evidence gap for the existing physical balcony drainage/waterproofing system without adding speculative visual score.

finding.summary: The existing balcony drainage/waterproofing implementation had render-facing geometry and detailed manufacture/material metadata, but the authoritative Native-4K packet did not explicitly persist/validate it and the detailed source contract was absent from the Danchi metadata contractPaths bundle.
finding.risk: Formal evidence could omit the intended 1:50 balcony fall, waterproofing returns and drainage hardware, or render pixels without sealing the detailed drainage construction/material contract into the construction-material SHA-256 evidence bundle.
finding.priorityReason: This directly limits trustworthy Geometry & construction, Material/PBR and Weathering/context evidence, so it outranks speculative scene expansion while Unity rendering is unavailable.

substantiveCommits.purpose: Define machine-readable Native-4K balcony drainage integration/lifecycle contract.
Add fail-closed formal integration QA for persisted build, phase ordering, central critical-ID membership and Danchi metadata binding.
Bind balcony_drainage_waterproofing_contract.json exactly once into the Danchi scene-metadata domain.

Make balcony drainage an explicit persisted pre-reflection member of the Native-4K packet with read-only validation at pre-reflection, post-reflection/pre-still and post-still/pre-temporal boundaries.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.geometry_construction: medium_to_high: formal frames should now deterministically include the actual balcony floor fall, waterproof returns, terminal drainage channel and grate construction rather than relying on editor lifecycle side effects
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.material_pbr: small_to_medium: the dry dielectric waterproof/coated drainage material state now travels through the same persisted reflection/still lifecycle
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.weathering_causality: medium: runoff and residue reasoning gains a physically represented gravity/drainage path in the formal scene
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.temporal_lod_aliasing: unscored risk: millimetric grate/sloped-edge behavior must be judged from sealed temporal pixels

failureInjectionPlanForFirstRealUnitySes: remove the single balcony drainage persisted build from the Native-4K packet and require formal preflight failure
move the persisted build to or after reflection synchronization and require formal preflight failure
remove any one of the three read-only lifecycle validation boundaries and require formal preflight failure
remove, duplicate or move balcony_drainage_waterproofing_contract.json out of the Danchi metadata domain and require formal preflight failure
disable domain contractPaths enumeration in the construction/material SHA-256 evidence binder and require formal preflight failure
replace a canonical critical-failure ID with a descriptive alias and require formal preflight failure
mutate balcony drainage geometry/material state after reflection synchronization and require later lifecycle validation failure
nextBlocker: A real Unity 6000.3.0f1 clean compile/runtime session is still required before failure injection, native 4K capture, 100% crops, temporal evidence and any Visual Fidelity scoring can occur.
